purpose: Durable worker bridge from the canonical 12 original textured furniture GLBs to the accepted v80 modular room/runtime contracts.

archival_backup.role: secondary immutable backup and independent provenance source

worker_retrieval_rules: Prefer the pinned GitHub LFS source_commit when a worker has repository and Git LFS access.
The source_path is on the sibling branch assets/celine-source-persistence, not on the active v80 implementation branch unless explicitly integrated later.
Treat the small Git blobs as Git LFS pointer metadata; the pointer oid sha256 and size identify the original GLB bytes.
Before any new geometry processing, verify all 12 filenames plus LFS oid/size against this bridge and SOURCE_SHA256SUMS.txt.
Never edit the original GLB bytes in place. Create derived/optimized workspace copies only.
If GitHub LFS is unavailable, the persistent Library path remains an authorized fallback; either source is acceptable only when all canonical hashes match.
Do not restore or substitute the superseded six untextured GLBs.

relationship_to_runtime.role_of_originals: immutable high-resolution source-of-origin for the room furniture/decor
relationship_to_runtime.role_of_runtime_room: optimized modular derivative used by the active v80 room/world implementation; raw 120-189 MB sources must not be copied directly into the APK
hard_relationship_rules: Canonical Celine remains a separate asset and is never baked into furniture or the room.
Furniture source identity is filename plus canonical SHA-256, independent of runtime transforms or optimization.
Position, rotation, scale, interaction anchors and navigation semantics belong to the room assembly/world contracts, not to mutations of the original GLBs.
Nachttisch.glb is one original source binary instantiated twice in the room.
Tischfürlaptop.glb is the physical foreground table; the laptop itself is the camera/viewer and must not be visible.
The lamp source is Lampe.glb; the reversible runtime light state is a separate floor_lamp_light entity and does not justify changing the original lamp GLB.
